properties.text: Every image in the list becomes a page, in list order. An animated GIF or multi-page TIFF contributes one page per frame.

Fitting scales each image to the page, keeping its shape, and turns the page sideways for a landscape picture. Sizing from the image instead makes the page as many points across as the picture has pixels - faithful, but photos record 72 DPI, so a phone photo becomes a page five feet wide.
A blank field leaves that attribute as it is. To clear everything, use "Remove all metadata".
Paints form fields and annotations into the page and removes the interactive objects. Nothing to configure - every field and annotation in the document is flattened.
Converts every page to shades of gray using the system Gray Tone filter. Nothing to configure.
Rewrites the file so a viewer can show the first page before the rest has downloaded. Nothing to configure.
Rewrites the document in an archival form that embeds its fonts and forbids external dependencies. Nothing to configure.
